description: This source file defines structures and functions for sharing content via deep links, including constructing URLs with message payloads and handling content sanitization and length limits.

classes.name: SharedContentPayload
classes.description: A data structure representing content to be shared, with optional title, URL, and text.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a custom deep link URL containing a message built from the payload and optional instruction.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string from the payload and instruction, applying sanitization and length limiting.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newline characters from a string, returning nil if the result is empty.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Restricts a string to a maximum number of characters.
